meta.scope: Curated, provenance-verified source index of authoritative/reusable projects and exact task resources for the requested model families (MiniMax H3, LTX-2.3/2.5 with IC-LoRAs and distilled paths, Qwen-Image 2.1 generation/editing, FLUX.1 Kontext/Krea variants, FLUX.2 Dev/Klein, Krea 2 RAW/Turbo) plus official ComfyUI tooling (ComfyUI core, comfy-cli and its agent skill, comfy-mcp, official workflow templates).
meta.status: runtime-unwired: no running code reads this index yet. It is intended as offline, locally retained input for a future resolver (e.g. the search_workflow_sources / get_source_recipe actions in plan section 8). It is not wired into the gateway, frontend, or any service.
disclaimer: This index is discovery metadata only. It is NOT a set of installed skills, NOT a runnable recipe collection, and NOT evidence that any listed file exists on any render backend.

Provenance verification here means: the repository/page/file path was confirmed to exist and its metadata was read on the verification date. It does NOT mean a model was downloaded, tested, rendered successfully, or is compatible with any particular backend or workflow.
Metadata discovery is not model compatibility: a documented model file or IC-LoRA may still be missing, version-mismatched, gated, or unsuitable for a given graph on any specific backend.
No entry in this index has been confirmed installed on any render backend (including Kamino-3). Dependency installation remains a separately authorized provisioning step (plan section 6).

verification.method: Read-only GitHub REST API (repo metadata, head commits, contents paths, LICENSE names), HuggingFace model API (id, gated status, revision sha, lastModified), and HTTP status/raw-file fetches of official documentation pages. No downloads, no service launches, no model loads, no live model calls.

sourceKinds.official: Comfy-Org / comfyanonymous repositories and docs.comfy.org documentation (platform owner).
sourceKinds.model-author: The organization that created the model (Lightricks, Qwen/Alibaba, MiniMax, Black Forest Labs, Krea).

familyLabels.note: Family labels are deliberately distinct and must not be merged by a resolver. Known confusions called out:

distinct.FLUX.1 Krea-dev vs Krea 2: FLUX.1 Krea-dev is a Black Forest Labs x Krea co-trained FLUX.1 dev variant (2025-07, gated). Krea 2 is Krea's own model family (RAW base / Turbo distilled, 2026-07). Different lineages, different schedules.
distinct.MiniMax H3 FL2VA vs Ref2VA: Separate diffusion checkpoints (minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot vs minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot). Never substitute one for the other.
distinct.Krea 2 RAW vs Krea 2 Turbo: RAW is the undistilled 52-step base; Turbo is the 8-step distilled checkpoint. LoRAs are trained on RAW and applied to Turbo.
distinct.Qwen-Image 2.1 base vs Turbo: Base samples in 25 steps; Turbo is a distilled 8-step checkpoint with its own prompt-enhancement encoders and separate Turbo/Lightning LoRA routes.
distinct.LTX-2.3 vs LTX-2.5: Different model generations with different file layouts (single-checkpoint plus Gemma 3 text encoder for 2.3; split transformer/encoders/VAEs for 2.5). IC-LoRAs are version-matched; cross-version compatibility must not be inferred.
distinct.LTX Ingredients vs Union Control (and ot: Ingredients is the composed-reference-sheet adapter with its exact two-part prompt format; Union Control, Motion Track, upscalers, HDR, layout, restore are separate adapters, each with its own recipe.
distinct.FastH3 vs MiniMax H3 base: FastH3 is the FastVideo DMD2-distilled 8-step route for text-to-video and first/last-frame image-to-video only; it is not a Ref2VA route.
distinct.FLUX.2 Dev vs FLUX.2 Klein: Klein is the small distilled-capable family (4B/9B, Base vs Distilled variants; Distilled is 4-step). Distilled Klein schedules must never be transferred to FLUX.2 Dev.
